title: One Day of Reels Would Take 4,400 Years
description:
Reels got over 140 billion views a day in 2022. Try watching one day.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Instagram: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram

Wikipedia (Instagram): in September 2022, Instagram Reels generated over 140 billion views daily. Our math: 140 billion / 86,400 seconds = about 1.6 million views a second; one second per view = 140 billion seconds, about 4,400 years; starting in 2026, you'd finish after the year 6400. Not financial advice.

#shorts #instagram #reels #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you swipe to the next Reel, remember:

scenes.narration: Reels got over 140 billion views a day in 2022. Try watching one day.
Just one day's worth. All by yourself.
Then picture it. Over a million views. Every single second.
Just one second per view? That's 4,400 years.
Start today, and you'd still be watching in the year 6400.
